title: Plush dinosaur, shell sewn in China, stuffed in Vietnam
description: Fabric is cut, sewn and embroidered into the body shell in China, then stuffed and finished in Vietnam. CBP held China (N343777, scenario 1): the cutting and sewing decide.
notes: One of the six families added in D660 (toys and build kits). Built from scenario 1 of CBP's ruling into a development fixture; plant capabilities, duty rates, import value and group costs are illustrative placeholders, not sourced. The ruling itself is excluded from precedent search. Picked by family, not by result. Recorded development run (eval/results/plan-plush-dinosaur-2024-local-verifier-v2-d660-litellm.json): the engine agreed with CBP on China at 0.98 stated, but no move cleared the 0.92 precedent bar; this card is an honest send-to-broker result, not a failed search. The closest below-bar move, cutting and sewing in Vietnam, checked 0.90 on N342448. Backtest: CBP held Vietnam in scenario 2 of the same ruling when the cutting and sewing moved there, so the bar kept a real change off the screen. A run on this site is a new run and may differ.
